checks.evidence: Authenticator is disabled when the consecutive failed attempt limit is reached, steps 1-3: repeated failures lead to rate limiting and refused authentication
Test 1 uses a generic limit L rather than 101 failures. It checks the disabled state only by a refused login, not by examining the subscriber account.
Test 3 step 2 says the authenticator is usable again only after the §3.2.2 procedure, but it does not name the authenticator binding procedure and does not show that no other way of using it exists.
